description: The line plot compares the Pass@1 Rate (%) of two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, across different numbers of reasoning steps. The x-axis, labeled "Num. of Reasoning Steps," is a linear scale ranging from 5 to 40, with data points at 5, 10, 20, and 40. The y-axis, labeled "Pass@1 Rate (%)," is also a linear scale from 0 to 100. The GPT-4o model, represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, shows a steady increase in performance, starting at 6.5% at 5 reasoning steps, rising to 32.3% at 10 steps, 77.4% at 20 steps, and reaching 83.9% at 40 steps. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet model, represented by a dashed light blue line with 'x' markers, also shows a consistent increase, starting at 19.4% at 5 steps, rising to 38.7% at 10 steps, 87.1% at 20 steps, and peaking at 89.2% at 40 steps. Both models exhibit improved performance with more reasoning steps, with Claude-3.5-Sonnet achieving higher Pass@1 rates at all measured points.
